explanation: Keevash–Lifshitz–Minzer, Theorem 1.1 (Green's Problem 4, marked Solved): for large n, every maximum-size product-free subset of A_n is, possibly after inversion, of the form {π : π(x) ∈ I, π(I) ∩ I = ∅}. These families are product-free: (ab)(x) = a(b(x)) ∉ I while c(x) ∈ I. They generalize Crane's example. MaximalFor with ncard on ℕ correctly means maximum size. The statement is a faithful structural formalization of the cited result.
